Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall partner on physical character robots

The partnership connects CharacterOS with robotic motion and expression, while retaining human involvement in operations.

The Robot Report ↗10 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2Videos 1

A partnership for physical characters

Dynamic Creatures is partnering with Sixth Wall Studio, Hasbro’s AI studio, on experiences delivered by mobile character robots. The new development is the partnership and character-governance approach, rather than another Hugo launch. Intended settings include theme parks, hotels, cruise ships and retail venues.

Connecting personality and expression

CharacterOS and Behavioral Licensing define authorized boundaries for personality, voice and behavior, connecting them to robotic movement and expression. The partners envisage venue-specific experiences and remembering guests with their consent, rather than unlicensed character use.

Human involvement continues

Initial experiences target audiences aged 13 and above, with humans still involved in the operational loop. The company describes a future transition from remote operation toward remote monitoring. That plan should not be read as proof of fully autonomous guest service or readiness for every venue.
